name: Chinmoku no Jogakuen ~Abikyoukan no Nikuyoku no Utage wa Owari o Miseru no ka~
original_name: 沈黙の女学園 ～阿鼻叫喚の肉欲の宴は終わりを見せるのか～
source:
Kamimori Akio is a new teacher at the Seiryo academy, a private school for young ladies of prominent families. He lives with her younger sister who also goes at the academy as him. He does a good job as a teacher and has gained the trust of both students and the academy's principal, however Akio has a problem that he cannot tell to anyone.

Which is a type of "unnatural libido" that makes his regular life weird.

Whenever he sees an attractive woman's body, he tries to hold his desires to rape her and goes to an abandoned toilet to jerk off, doing his best to be "the good new teacher" for months.

However, his twisted daily life... ended up in one instant after he was discovered by a woman.

Niinami Mizono, an strange female teacher that came to the academy a little earlier than Akio, carries out an unprecedented "school hijacking" incident.

And now, the curtain for a party of madness opens...
translation:
上森明夫是星棱学园的新老师，这是一所专门为名门望族的年轻女子开设的私立学校。他和她的妹妹住在一起，她的妹妹也和他一样在学校上学。作为一名出色的老师，他赢得了学生和学院校长的信任，但秋夫有一个不能告诉任何人的问题。

这是一种“非自然性欲”，使他的正常生活变得怪异。

每当他看到一个有吸引力的女人的身体时，他就会试图抑制住强奸她的欲望，然后去一个废弃的厕所里打飞机，几个月来尽最大努力成为“好新老师”。

然而，他扭曲的日常生活……却在被女人发现后的一瞬间结束了。

比明夫早一点来到学园的奇怪女教师新南水野，实施了史无前例的“学校劫持”事件。

现在，一场疯狂派对的帷幕拉开了……
